threshold_note: threshold is rolling (window per lookback); threshold_value is the latest rolling value — see winner_trade_log.csv for the full path
strategy_description: Long SPY when the lagged Cass Freight signal is above its threshold; otherwise cash. (Countercyclical orientation: low/decelerating freight = risk-on.)
lead_description: Signal lead = 13 month(s); L1 is the real-time floor given Cass's ~2-week publication lag

selection.objective_formula: oos_ret.mean()/oos_ret.std()*sqrt(12), maximised over the valid population but with a SEASONAL-ROBUSTNESS constraint (seasonally-CLEAN signals only) applied per Dana's NSA Phase-0 gate; the raw-max override is disclosed in objective_runner_up_divergence (ECON-T5 §3)
selection.rationale: Maximiser of OOS Sharpe among SEASONALLY-CLEAN signals over the full tradable monthly lead grid L1..L12 (6670 clean valid combos of 12422 total valid; median clean OOS Sharpe 0.7639). Objective is restricted to clean signals because the Cass series is NSA (Dana Phase-0 binding constraint) — see objective_runner_up_divergence. ECON-LT1 gate: L*=3, CHARTS-ONLY. SHORT-HISTORY CAVEAT: OOS <5yr -> CANDIDATE (found-in-search), not a validated edge; Granger/CCF find no forward causality.
selection.objective_runner_up_divergence: The globally highest-raw-OOS-Sharpe valid combo was NOT published. That row (accel/T2_roll_p25/P3_long_short_pro/L3/LB36, OOS Sharpe 1.4724) is built on a SEASONALLY-CONTAMINATED signal (the Cass series is NOT seasonally adjusted, so MoM/3M/6M/level-zscore transforms carry a seasonal component that inflates in-window fit). The published winner is the max-OOS-Sharpe combo among SEASONALLY-CLEAN signals (YoY-family / 12M-MA-derived / regime), OOS Sharpe 1.3354 — a Δ of only -0.137. Preferring the clean signal is sound because a seasonally-driven edge is not a genuine goods-cycle signal and would not generalise out of its seasonal alignment; the criterion is a binding Phase-0 data-quality constraint (Dana), not an ex-post rationalisation. NOTE: on this ~36-month (<5yr) OOS both combos are found-in-search CANDIDATES; Granger/CCF find NO forward causality (see notes), so this divergence is between two artifacts, not two validated edges.
